Visitor removes embedded iframes

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_iframe(self, ctx, src):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = '<h3>Reviews</h3><iframe src="https://widget.example.com/reviews"></iframe><p>See reviews from our partners.</p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
